desc: Building upon the legacy of the renowned T6Xi series, the H6Xi brings tactical DNA to your hunt. Every component is meticulously designed to withstand the rigors of the field while maintaining exceptional optical clarity. Milled from solid aerospace-grade 6061-T6 aluminum, the H6Xi 30mm tube delivers a rugged waterproof, fog proof, and shockproof design with weight and compactness in mind. The Modern Hunter Reticle (MHR) presents duplex crosshairs for quick aiming in the lower magnification range and precise, illuminated denotation for wind drift and bullet drop when zoomed in for distant shots.
